items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: 'immigration' topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: What are the benefits and drawbacks of immigration or multi-cultural societies?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here is a paragraph giving some of the economic benefits of immigration:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: From an economic perspective, immigration can be extremely positive.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Many immigrants have skills that are needed in the country they move to.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: For example, countries sometimes lack key workers like doctors and nurses, and immigration is therefore encouraged.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Immigrants who find work contribute to the economy of their new country with the skills they bring and the taxes they pay.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: At the same time, many immigrants send money to help family members in their home country, therefore helping to boost that economy too.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Explain some of the ways in which humans are damaging the environment. What can governments do to address these problems? What can individual people do?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Humans are responsible for a variety of environmental problems, but we can also take steps to reduce the damage that we are causing to the planet. This essay will discuss environmental problems and the measures that governments and individuals can take to address these problems.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Two of the biggest threats to the environment are air pollution and waste.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Gas emissions from factories and exhaust fumes from vehicles lead to global warming, which may have a devastating effect on the planet in the future.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: As the human population increases, we are also producing ever greater quantities of waste, which contaminates the earth and pollutes rivers and oceans.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Governments could certainly make more effort to reduce air pollution.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They could introduce laws to limit emissions from factories or to force companies to use renewable energy from solar, wind or water power.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They could also impose ‘green taxes’ on drivers and airline companies. In this way, people would be encouraged to use public transport and to take fewer flights abroad, therefore reducing emissions.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Individuals should also take responsibility for the impact they have on the environment.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can take public transport rather than driving, choose products with less packaging, and recycle as much as possible. Most supermarkets now provide reusable bags for shoppers as well as ‘banks’ for recycling glass, plastic and paper in their car parks. By reusing and recycling, we can help to reduce waste.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: In conclusion, both national governments and individuals must play their part in looking after the environment.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Note: This essay is exactly 250 words long. I've tried to make it as simple as possible, but it's still good enough to get a band 9.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: studying abroad

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: More and more students are choosing to study at colleges and universities in a foreign country. Do the benefits of studying abroad outweigh the drawbacks?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here are some ideas from my ebook:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Benefits of studying abroad:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Many students travel abroad to study at a prestigious university.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The best universities employ lecturers who are experts in their fields.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Qualifications gained abroad can open doors to better job opportunities.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Living in a foreign country can broaden students' horizons.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Overseas students are exposed to different cultures and customs.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can immerse themselves in a language.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Drawbacks of studying abroad:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Living away from home can be challenging.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Students have problems with paperwork such as visa applications.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The language barrier can cause difficulties.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Students have to find accommodation and pay bills.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Many students feel homesick and miss their families.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some students experience culture shock.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Which of the words or phrases above do you think would be considered band 7 or higher?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: "Band 7 Vocabulary"

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: When I say "band 7 vocabulary", I'm really talking about vocabulary that could help you to get a band 7 or higher. Examiners are looking for "less common" words and phrases, correct and relevant collocations, and maybe some idiomatic language.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: I've written the following paragraph using some of the ideas from the lesson below. I've underlined the band 7 (or higher) vocabulary.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advantages of studying abroad:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 1,Many students choose to study abroad because there are greater opportunities in a particular foreign country.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 2,Foreign universities may offer better facilities or courses.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 3, They may also be more prestigious than universities in the student’s own country and have teachers who are experts in their fields.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 4,Therefore, by studying abroad, students can expand their knowledge and gain qualifications that open the door to better job opportunities.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 5, A period of study abroad can also broaden students’ horizons.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 6,In the new country, they will have to live and work with other students of various nationalities. Thus, overseas students are exposed to different cultures, customs and points of view.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: crime topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here is a "problem/solution" question, with some ideas for an essay below:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Many criminals re-offend after they have been punished. Why do some people continue to commit crimes after they have been punished, and what measures can be taken to tackle this problem?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Causes of crime and re-offending:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The main causes of crime are poverty, unemployment and lack of education.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: People who commit crimes often have no other way of making a living.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The prison system can make the situation worse.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Offenders mix with other criminals who can be a negative influence.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: A criminal record makes finding a job more difficult.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Many prisoners re-offend when they are released.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Possible measures to reduce crime and re-offending:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Prisons should provide education or vocational training.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Rehabilitation programmes prepare prisoners for release into society.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Community service is another way to reform offenders.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It makes offenders useful in their local communities.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They might be required to talk to school groups or clean public areas.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Offenders also need help when looking for accommodation and work.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: There are more ideas about topics like police, prisons, capital punishment and community service in my ebook.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: 'zoo' topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some people believe that it is wrong to keep animals in zoos, while others think that zoos are both entertaining and ecologically important. Discuss both views.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here are some (band 7 or higher) vocabulary ideas. I've organised the vocabulary according to different perspectives.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Positives of keeping animals in zoos:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Environmental perspective: Zoos play an important role in wildlife conservation. They help to protect endangered species. They allow scientists to study animal behaviour.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Economic perspective: Zoos employ large numbers of people. They provide job opportunities and income for the local area. The money raised can be used for conservation projects.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Personal perspective: Zoos are interesting, educational and fun. They make a great day out for families. Children learn to appreciate wildlife and nature.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Negatives of zoos:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Environmental perspective: Zoos are artificial environments. Animals lose their instinct to hunt for food. It would be better to save endangered species by protecting their natural habitats.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Moral perspective: Keeping animals in cages is unethical. We have no right to use animals for entertainment. Zoos exhibit animals with the aim of making a profit.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Thinking about topics from different perspectives is a useful technique. It helps you to generate a variety of interesting ideas. I used this technique when thinking of ideas for my ebook, and I encourage my students to use it when planning their essays.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Several students have asked me to help them with this IELTS question:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some people think that school children need to learn practical skills such as car maintenance or bank account management along with the academic subjects at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here are some suggestions (this is NOT an essay):

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 1. Introduce the topic then give your opinion I would write that it is true that children learn academic subjects at school, but not many practical skills. However, I would then disagree that schools should teach skills like bank account management and car maintenance.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 2. First supporting paragraph I would write a paragraph about the importance of academic subjects like maths, science, languages etc. We live in a knowledge-based economy where independent thinking and problem solving are the most important skills. With timetables already full, schools do not have time to teach children anything else.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 3. Second supporting paragraph I would argue that bank account management is a 'life skill' that anyone can learn by simply opening a bank account. Most adults have no problem managing their finances without being taught accounting lessons at school. Other skills like car maintenance are not really necessary. Most people take their cars to a qualified mechanic.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 4. Conclusion Repeat the idea that schools are already doing a good job teaching the traditional academic subjects. If they start to teach practical skills, the study of important academic subjects will suffer.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: globalisation

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here is an essay question on the topic of globalisation:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It has been said that the world is becoming a global village in which there are no boundaries to trade and communication. Do the benefits of globalisation outweigh the drawbacks?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Yesterday's video contained some useful ideas, but here are some more ideas from my ebook:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Positives of globalisation:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Business is becoming increasingly international.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: A global economy means free trade between countries.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: This can strengthen political relationships.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Globalisation can also create opportunities for employment.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It encourages investment in less developed countries.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It could reduce poverty in the developing world.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Negatives of globalisation:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Globalisation can also lead to unemployment and exploitation.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Companies move to countries where labour is cheap.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: This creates redundancies, or job losses.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some companies exploit their employees in developing countries.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Salaries are low and working conditions are often poor.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Global trade also creates excessive waste and pollution.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Note: The American English spelling is 'globalization'. You can use either spelling in the IELTS test.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: advertising topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertising is a very common topic in both the IELTS writing and speaking tests. Here are some ideas from my ebook that you could learn.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Positives of advertising:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Companies need to tell customers about their products and services.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertisements inform us about the choices we have.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The advertising industry employs many people.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertisements are often funny, artistic or thought-provoking.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Negatives of advertising:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertisers aim to convince us that buying things leads to happiness.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: We are persuaded to follow the latest trends and fashions.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Children can be easily influenced by advertisements.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They put pressure on their parents by pestering or nagging.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertising should be regulated by governments.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Advertisements that target children should be banned.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Packaging for junk food should display clear health warnings.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Overall, advertising is necessary but it needs to be controlled.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: tourism

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Do the benefits of tourism outweigh the drawbacks?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here are some ideas. I've organised the vocabulary according to different perspectives (different ways of looking at this issue).

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Positives of tourism:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Personal perspective:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourism is a popular leisure activity.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourists can relax, have fun, 'recharge their batteries', experience different customs and cultures (sight-seeing, sunbathing, visiting monuments, tasting new cuisine).

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Travel opens our minds. It can broaden our horizons.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Economic perspective:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The tourism industry is vital for some countries. People rely on tourism for their income.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourism attracts investment from governments and companies.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It creates employment due to demand for goods and services (hotels, entertainment etc.).

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It helps to improve the standard of living.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Negatives of tourism:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Environmental perspective:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourism can have a negative impact on the environment. Excessive building (roads, hotels etc.) destroys natural habitats and spoils the landscape.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourism creates pollution and waste. It puts pressure on local resources such as food, water and energy.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourism may cause a rise in the cost of living. Prices of goods and services go up.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Tourists buy second homes. All of this affects local people.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Cultural perspective: Local traditions may be lost. Traditional jobs and skills die out (e.g. farming, fishing). Local people are forced to work in the tourist industry.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Thinking about topics from different perspectives can help you to generate better ideas. This technique isn't perfect for every topic, but it can be really useful.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: technology

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here is a question that a student asked me about:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some people believe that the range of technology available to individuals today is increasing the gap between rich people and poor people, while others say that technology has the opposite effect. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: I'd write a 4-paragraph essay:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Introduction: introduce the topic and give your view

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The other view (that you agree with)

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Conclusion: repeat your view

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Technology could increase the gap between rich and poor.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Rich people have smartphones, laptops, wireless broadband Internet etc.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: People in developed countries can now work from home or from anywhere in the world. They can do their shopping online and have things delivered to their homes.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Technology improves their quality of life.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: On the other hand, many people in poorer countries, who did not have normal telephones, now have mobile phones.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Also, the Internet is spreading to all parts of the world. In the past, only people in developed countries had access to world-class libraries, but now the Internet gives everyone access to the same information. This will lead to greater equality.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: city problems

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: More and more people are migrating to cities in search of a better life, but city life can be extremely difficult. Explain some of the difficulties of living in a city. How can governments make urban life better for everyone?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here are some band 7 vocabulary ideas from my ebook for describing city problems:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Life in cities has its drawbacks.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The cost of living is higher than in rural areas.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Housing is usually much more expensive.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Homelessness and poverty are common in cities.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: There is a gap between the rich and poor.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Life in cities can be extremely stressful.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: There are problems like traffic congestion and crime.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Cities lack a sense of community.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: People do not even know their neighbours.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Cities are sometimes described as “concrete jungles”.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Can you suggest any solutions to these problems? Watch yesterday's video for some ideas.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: governments

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: A lot of IELTS Writing questions ask you to give opinions about what governments should do in relation to an issue. Governments can have an influence on almost everything: environment, crime, television, advertising, work etc.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: As part of your IELTS preparation, you should think about what governments can do in relation to IELTS topics. Here are some ideas from my ebook:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Governments provide public services like healthcare and education.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They introduce new laws.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They raise money by taxing working people.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can spend money on campaigns to educate people.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can raise people's awareness of issues.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can create new jobs.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can provide resources for schools, hospitals etc.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: They can support people who are living in poverty or unable to work.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: So, if the question asks you to suggest what governments should do to reduce obesity, you could write this:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: "In my opinion, governments should spend money on campaigns to educate people about the importance of regular exercise and a healthy diet. Perhaps they should also introduce new laws to ban the advertising of junk food to children."

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Think about some other IELTS topics. What do you think governments should do?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS writing Task 2: health topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Despite huge improvements in healthcare, the overall standard of physical health in many developed countries is now falling. What could be the reason for this trend, and what can be done to reverse it?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Here is a paragraph about causes of poor health:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Lifestyle is a major cause of poor health in developed countries. Most people now travel by car rather than walking, and machines now perform many traditional manual jobs. As a result, people tend to work in offices where little physical activity is required. At home, people are also less active; most adults relax by watching television, while children play video games rather than doing outdoor sports. Technology has therefore made our lives more comfortable but perhaps less healthy.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Can you suggest any solutions to these lifestyle problems? PS. There are more ideas for this topic in my ebook.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: 'minority languages' essay

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Today, I'd like to share a 'band 9' sample essay for the question below.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Several languages are in danger of extinction because they are spoken by very small numbers of people. Some people say that governments should spend public money on saving these languages, while others believe that would be a waste of money. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It is true that some minority languages may disappear in the near future. Although it can be argued that governments could save money by allowing this to happen, I believe that these languages should be protected and preserved.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: There are several reasons why saving minority languages could be seen as a waste of money.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Firstly, if a language is only spoken by a small number of people, expensive education programmes will be needed to make sure that more people learn it, and the state will have to pay for facilities, teachers and marketing. This money might be better spent on other public services.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Secondly, it would be much cheaper and more efficient for countries to have just one language. Governments could cut all kinds of costs related to communicating with each minority group.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Despite the above arguments, I believe that governments should try to preserve languages that are less widely spoken.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: A language is much more than simply a means of communication; it has a vital connection with the cultural identity of the people who speak it. If a language disappears, a whole way of life will disappear with it, and we will lose the rich cultural diversity that makes societies more interesting.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: By spending money to protect minority languages, governments can also preserve traditions, customs and behaviours that are part of a country’s history.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: In conclusion, it may save money in the short term if we allow minority languages to disappear, but in the long term this would have an extremely negative impact on our cultural heritage.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: 'dependence' question

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The following question was used in several countries last Saturday. I've listed some ideas below.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Some people think that in the modern world we have become more dependent on each other, while others think that people are now more independent. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: First view: we have become more dependent

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Life is more difficult and expensive, and we are less self-sufficient

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Young people rely on their parents for longer

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Unemployed people receive state benefits

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Our jobs are much more specialised, and we need to work in teams

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Second view: we are more independent

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: We rely on machines more than we depend on each other

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The Internet allows us to solve problems without needing help

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Families are more dispersed, and therefore provide less support

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Education gives us the freedom to make our own choices

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: By linking these points together and supporting them with examples, you could easily write two good paragraphs.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: IELTS Writing Task 2: 'job satisfaction' topic

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: As most people spend a major part of their adult life at work, job satisfaction is an important element of individual well-being. What factors contribute to job satisfaction? How realistic is the expectation of job satisfaction for all workers?

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: The following paragraph answers the second part of the question (How realistic..)

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: It is difficult to imagine a world in which everyone is truly satisfied with their job. Most people work in order to earn a salary, and they would probably not choose to spend eight or more hours each day doing their jobs if they did not need the money. The need to earn money to pay mortgages, bills and everyday living costs is of much greater concern than job satisfaction. In fact, I would argue that the majority of people dislike their jobs and are unhappy about their salaries, working hours, workloads, or their bosses.

items.content: ELTS Writing: 'gender and university' essay

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Universities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Here are some ideas:

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 1. Introduction: We decided to completely disagree with the question statement. You don't need to

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: explain both sides of the argument. Just give your opinion in the introduction, and then support it in the main body paragraphs.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 2. Paragraph 2: One reason why we decided to disagree is that it would not be practical or realistic to have exactly the same number of males and females on every course. Some courses have mainly male applicants, while others are more popular with females.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 3. Paragraph 3: Another reason we disagreed is that it would not be fair to base admission to

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: courses on gender. Universities should select candidates based on their qualifications, skills, experience etc.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: 4. Conclusion: Repeat the idea that selecting according to gender is not the best way to ensure

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: equal opportunities for men and women at university.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: In my opinion, men and women should have the same educational opportunities. However, I do not agree with the idea of accepting equal proportions of each gender in every university subject.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Having the same number of men and women on all degree courses is simply unrealistic.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Student numbers on any course depend on the

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: applications that the institution receives.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: If a university decided to fill courses with equal numbers of males and females, it would need enough applicants of each gender.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: In reality, many courses are more popular with

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: one gender than the other, and it would not be practical to aim for equal proportions. For example, nursing coursestend to attract more female applicants, and it would be difficult to fill these courses if fifty per cent of the places needed to go to males.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: Apart from the practical concerns expressed above, I also believe that it would be unfair to base

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: admission to university courses on gender. Universities should continue to select the best candidates for each course according to their qualifications. In this way, both men and women have the same opportunities, and applicants know that they will be successful if they work hard to achieve good grades at school. If a female student is the best candidate for a place on a course, it would be wrong to reject her in favor of a male student with lower grades or fewer qualifications.

items.title: Simon 作文整理 2
items.content: In conclusion, the selection of university students should be based on merit, and it would be both impractical and unfair to change to a selection procedure based on gender.
